name: flaggems_fused_moving_avg_obs_fq_helper
description: Fused moving-average min/max observer + fake quantize helper (per-tensor or per-channel) used in quantization-aware training. Updates running_min/running_max via exponential moving average when observer_on, recomputes scale/zero_point from the running stats, applies affine fake quantization when fake_quant_on, and returns (quantized output, mask) where mask marks elements whose unclamped q = round(x/scale)+zero_point lies within [quant_min, quant_max].
reference:
import torch

def gen_inputs(ctx, device):
    x = torch.randn(tuple(ctx['x__shape']), dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
    obs_val = ctx.get('observer_on__value', 1)
    fq_val = ctx.get('fake_quant_on__value', 1)
    observer_on = torch.tensor([obs_val], dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
    fake_quant_on = torch.tensor([fq_val], dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
    n = 1
    if 'running_min__shape' in ctx and ctx['running_min__shape']:
        n = 1
        for s in ctx['running_min__shape']:
            n *= s
    running_min = -torch.arange(1, n + 1, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
    running_max = torch.arange(1, n + 1, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
    scale = torch.full((n,), 0.1, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
    zero_point = torch.zeros(n, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
    return {
        'x': x,
        'observer_on': observer_on,
        'fake_quant_on': fake_quant_on,
        'running_min': running_min,
        'running_max': running_max,
        'scale': scale,
        'zero_point': zero_point,
    }

def run(x, observer_on, fake_quant_on, running_min, running_max, scale, zero_point,
        averaging_const, quant_min, quant_max, ch_axis, per_row_fake_quant, symmetric_quant):
    rm = running_min.clone()
    rx = running_max.clone()
    sc = scale.clone()
    zp = zero_point.clone()
    output, mask = torch._fused_moving_avg_obs_fq_helper(
        x, observer_on, fake_quant_on, rm, rx, sc, zp,
        averaging_const, quant_min, quant_max, ch_axis,
        per_row_fake_quant, symmetric_quant)
    return output, mask
